affirmations: I am capable of handling whatever today brings.
I don't have to be perfect to be worthy.
Small steps still move me forward.
I choose progress over perfection.
I am allowed to take up space.
I can do hard things.
My effort today is enough.
I learn something from every setback.
I trust myself to figure it out.
I am patient with myself while I grow.
I deserve rest as much as I deserve success.
I focus on what I can control.
Today I choose curiosity over fear.
I am becoming the person I want to be.
My worth is not measured by my productivity.
I am grateful for this moment.
I can start again at any time.
I give myself permission to slow down.
I speak to myself with kindness.
I am proud of how far I have come.
Mistakes are proof that I am trying.
I bring something unique to the world.
I let go of what I cannot change.
I am open to new possibilities.
Calm is a choice, and I choose it now.
I show up for myself today.
I am strong enough to ask for help.
My boundaries are healthy and necessary.
I create my own sense of peace.
Every day is a fresh start.
I am resilient, and I keep going.
I celebrate small wins.
I honor my feelings without being ruled by them.
I am enough, exactly as I am.
I can be both a work in progress and a masterpiece.
I do one thing at a time, and I do it well.
I choose to see the good around me.
My future is shaped by what I do today.
I am in charge of how I respond.
I attract good things by being myself.
I release comparison and run my own race.
I am worthy of the dreams I hold.
Today I will be a little braver than yesterday.
I breathe in calm and breathe out tension.

quotes.text: You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: While we are postponing, life speeds by.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: No man is free who is not master of himself.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.text: What you get by achieving your goals is not as important as what you become by achieving your goals.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.text: Do not go where the path may lead, go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: To be yourself in a world that is constantly trying to make you something else is the greatest accomplishment.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: Write it on your heart that every day is the best day in the year.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.text: Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
quotes.author: Will Durant

quotes.text: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.text: Whatever you can do, or dream you can, begin it.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.text: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.text: Life can only be understood backwards; but it must be lived forwards.
quotes.author: Søren Kierkegaard

quotes.text: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.text: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance you must keep moving.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.text: Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
quotes.author: Marie Curie

quotes.text: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quotes.text: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quotes.text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.text: Keep your face always toward the sunshine — and shadows will fall behind you.
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.text: Well done is better than well said.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: Energy and persistence conquer all things.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: I am not afraid of storms, for I am learning how to sail my ship.
quotes.author: Louisa May Alcott

quotes.text: If you're going through hell, keep going.
quotes.author: Winston Churchill

quotes.text: Be not afraid of growing slowly; be afraid only of standing still.
quotes.author: Chinese Proverb

quotes.text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
quotes.author: Japanese Proverb

quotes.text: The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
quotes.author: Chinese Proverb

quotes.text: Happiness is not something ready made. It comes from your own actions.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama

quotes.text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: It always seems impossible until it's done.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela
